cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Challenge by Proxy
cards.instruction: Persuade someone else to challenge a rule or authority before you risk doing it yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I crossed out my court booking like you did. Tell the captain we're protesting his queue-jumping rule.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I cancelled because my ankle hurts. I still want a court next week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, we're protecting next week's bookings. You ask him to end queue-jumping before you rebook.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He'll cancel that booking too if I complain. Come with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You ask first. If he offers you next week's court, wave me over and I'll tell him I support you.
